envelope.description: CloudEvents 1.0 structured mode. The same envelope on the stream, the feed and webhooks.

causationid.description: Id of the event or request that caused this one.

classification.description: Highest data classification in the payload; restricted payloads carry references only.

id.description: Type-prefixed ULID, unique per event, the same across redeliveries.

onbehalfof.description: The person an agent, connector or client acted for.

organisationid.description: The one organisation the event belongs to. Always present; taken from the transaction's tenant setting, never from the payload.

sequence.description: Per-organisation, strictly increasing position; gaps are allowed, reordering is not.

subject.description: API path of the record the event is about.
